venue.name: Salt Palace Convention Center
venue.address: 90 South West Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
venue.additional_venue_address: 170 South West Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

coverage.pagination: All endpoint is a single JSON object with sessions/speakers/rooms/categories/questions; no pagination. GridSmart supplies all five days in one array.
coverage.embedded_vs_api: Only session description representation differs: embedded HTML vs API text; all other session fields match.
coverage.scope_warning: 601 main records include breaks, registration, showcase and co-located umbrella entries; not 601 technical talks. Related datasets are separate and overlap main umbrella events; never blindly concatenate or interpret counts as unique talks.

access.cncf_hosted_colocated: All-Access pass required for Monday CNCF-hosted events. No specific co-located event selection required.
access.main_only_pass: Includes Nov 10-12 and Monday Project Lightning Talks, excludes Monday CNCF-hosted co-located events.
access.sponsor_hosted: Separate registrations and eligibility may apply; use exact session descriptions and labels.
access.seating: First come, first served; favorite does not reserve a seat.
access.accessibility: Reserved session seating available. Ask event staff at registration/info desks for elevators and onsite accessibility help. Nursing room location is available from staff; no specific room inferred.
access.wifi_status: Not found in pages retrieved; no SSID/password inferred.
access.maintainer_summit: Separate registration plus KubeCon registration and eligibility requirements; consult preserved maintainer-summit page. Not a general main-conference session.

logistics.entrances: Venue PDF labels 200 South Main Entrance, West Temple Entrance, badge re-entry, and Hyatt/Salt Palace connection. See PDF; no route geometry inferred.
logistics.map_coverage: Salt Palace levels 1-3 and Hyatt levels 1-5. Main schedule requires Hyatt levels 2,3,4,5 as well as Salt Palace. L1-L3-only single-building map is insufficient.

refresh_advice.status: Implementation recommendation, not official polling policy
refresh_advice.text: Re-fetch official All and GridSmart endpoints before import and during event at a respectful interval; diff stable IDs, start/end and room IDs. Preserve favorites by dataset+id, display snapshot time and timezone, handle removals/cancellations, and refresh map redirect targets. No official refresh SLA found.
refresh_advice.agenda_sync: Organizer app guide says favorites stored locally by default; sync code supports cross-device favorites and can take up to 5 minutes. Do not scrape user sync codes.
